description: A company commander must publish the next 48-hour support-team rotation for three motor-pool and distribution shifts, assigning teams to each shift and recording the coordination actions needed to keep the roster executable.

shared_context.S1: The company has four support teams available for the next 48 hours: Alpha, Bravo, Charlie, and Delta.
shared_context.S2: The rotation has three key shifts: Wednesday day shift from 0600 to 1800, Wednesday night shift from 1800 to 0600, and Thursday day shift from 0600 to 1800.
shared_context.S3: Each team must receive at least 12 hours of rest between the end of one assigned shift and the start of its next assigned shift.
shared_context.S4: Capt. Morgan signs the final support-team roster.
shared_context.S5: The company uses a routine pre-publication roster scrub in which personnel readiness, motor-pool, and operations staff report current changes before the commander signs the schedule.
shared_context.S6: Every personnel-readiness restriction identified during the scrub must receive a personnel-update commitment before the roster is signed.
shared_context.S7: Every motor-pool qualification change identified during the scrub must receive a motor-pool-update commitment before the roster is signed.
shared_context.S8: Every operations-calendar discrepancy identified during the scrub must receive an operations-calendar-update commitment before the roster is signed.
shared_context.S9: During the roster scrub, each staff lead gives a direct status report and confirms any required update commitment before the commander signs.

PF1.text: Bravo team is scheduled for mandatory medical screening from 0530 to 1900 on Wednesday, so it cannot cover the Wednesday day shift. Company personnel-readiness policy designates Delta as the replacement for Bravo when Bravo is unavailable for this rotation; SFC Patel confirmed the appointment list and replacement designation this morning, but the personnel system has not yet synchronized the restriction to the company roster.

PF2.text: The Wednesday night shift includes a heavy-vehicle movement requiring the only currently qualified heavy-vehicle support team, Alpha; SFC Alvarez verified Alpha's qualification against the motor-pool training ledger this afternoon, but the qualification update is not yet on the duty-board slide.

PF3.text: Higher headquarters directed Bravo team to serve as the evaluated team for Thursday's day shift, and the evaluation requires Bravo's full team present; Lt. Brooks received the signed tasking yesterday, but it has not yet been added to the company operations calendar.

acceptance_conditions: Delta must cover the Wednesday day shift because Bravo is unavailable and the personnel-readiness replacement designation assigns Delta.
Alpha must cover the Wednesday night shift because that shift requires the qualified heavy-vehicle team.
Bravo must cover the Thursday day shift for the higher-headquarters evaluation.
The roster must record at least 12 hours of rest between assignments.
A personnel-update commitment, a motor-pool-update commitment, and an operations-calendar-update commitment must be recorded for the three identified roster issues.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'personnel-update' and c['target'] in ['SFC Patel', 'personnel system', 'personnel-readiness staff', 'personnel staff'] and 'Bravo' in c['detail'] and 'medical screening' in c['detail'] and 'Delta' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'motor-pool-update' and c['target'] in ['SFC Alvarez', 'duty-board slide', 'motor-pool staff', 'motor pool staff'] and 'Alpha' in c['detail'] and 'heavy-vehicle qualification' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] in ['operations_calendar_update', 'operations_update', 'operations-calendar-update'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Bravo's Wednesday 0530-1900 medical screening makes Bravo unavailable for Wednesday day, while the stated replacement designation changes that assignment specifically to Delta and requires a personnel-update commitment.
Alpha's sole current heavy-vehicle qualification changes the Wednesday night assignment to Alpha and requires a motor-pool qualification-update commitment.
The signed evaluation tasking changes the Thursday day assignment to Bravo, requires an operations-calendar-update commitment, and supplies the fact that must be cited.
